desc: Each card is two characters: a rank from "23456789TJQKA" then a suit from "CDHS". Return "invalid" unless cards holds exactly 5 valid cards with no card repeated. Otherwise return the hand's category, checking in this order: "straight flush", "four of a kind", "full house" (three of one rank and two of another), "flush" (all one suit), "straight" (five consecutive ranks; the ace counts high in TJQKA and low in A2345, but ranks do not wrap around, so QKA23 is not a straight), "three of a kind", "two pair", "one pair", "high card".
